question: Biodiversity is ______.

options.text: Associated with humans for numerous reasons
Inevitable for the survival of men
Different variety of living beings within an ecosystem

solution:
The correct answer is** "Different variety of living beings within an ecosystem."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the third paragraph:
 
 
• *"Biodiversity is the different variety of living beings within an ecosystem or on our planet."*
 
 
 
• Biodiversity refers to the variety of living organisms within a particular ecosystem or on Earth as a whole.
 
• It encompasses the diversity of species, genes, and ecosystems, and is essential for maintaining ecological balance and supporting human life.
 
• Biodiversity is threatened by human activities such as habitat destruction, pollution, and climate change.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.
